caption: The screen Select Your Account Plan inside the app: Essential - $29 billed monthly (14-day free trial, 1 Customer Tag, Manual Customer Tagging, Tax Controls, Unlimited Quantity Breaks), Standard - $65 billed monthly marked Most popular (1-10 Customer Tags, Auto-Emails, Auto-Tagging) and Complete - $129 billed monthly (Unlimited Customer Tags, Advanced Detailed Pricing, CSV Price Imports, Shopify POS Integration, Expert Setup, Premier Support, SLA), each with an UPGRADE button; the store name is hidden.

The list of pricing groups in the app with one group Wholesale 20 percent off, the label Sync queued and the status switched on, under a notice Syncing 0 items with Shopify, 1 items in queue and Product prices will not be updated until its process is synced, with the label In Queue; the price was therefore not yet changed in the store; the store name is hidden.
